notes: Not in the pilot. Phillip Life Assurance (บริษัท ฟิลลิปประกันชีวิต จำกัด (มหาชน)). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; the statements' own folio + 44 = file page). CAR disclosure p.1-32, auditor's report from p.33. Units differ: the SCI (p.40) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision: separate statements). The separate statements account for the subsidiary by the equity method; its share of loss is included in other income (net), as the share of an associate is elsewhere. The insurance notes are common to both. Note 6.1 (columns non-PAA 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / total): 2568 revenue p.94, expenses p.95; 2567 p.96. Incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward (note 7.1, untitled reconciliation by measurement component): 2568 p.102-103, 2567 p.104-105; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business p.106 (both years); totals used (the onerous column of 2568 shows a CSM of 13,470). RA release uses 6.1, equal to the AOC RA. Other expense = finance costs + other operating expenses.
